CITY OF BALDWIN PARK
COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 02, 2010
7:00 p.m. COUNCIL CHAMBERS
14403 E. Pacific Avenue
Baldwin Park
Manuel Lozano, Mayor/Chair
Ricardo Pacheco, Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Marlen Garcia, Monica Garcia, Susan Rubio Council Members/Members
Maria Contreras, City Treasurer Alejandra Avila, City Clerk
The COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION of the City of Baldwin Park met in REGULAR SESSION at the above time and place.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
Present: Member Marlen Garcia, Member Rubio, Vice Chair Pacheco, Chair Lozano.
Absent: Member Monica Garcia.
Also Present: Chief Executive Officer Singhal, City Attorney Pannone, Recreation & Community Services Director Carrillo, Public Works Director Galvez, Chief Hadsell, Finance Director Quijano, City Clerk Avila, City Treasurer Contreras, Deputy City Clerk Nieto.
PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS
NONE
CONSENT CALENDAR
Motion: Approve CONSENT CALENDAR
Moved by Chair Lozano, seconded by Vice Chair Pacheco.
1. WARRANTS AND DEMANDS
Staff Report
Commission received and filed.
2. MINUTES
Staff Report
Commission approved the minutes of the special and regular meetings of May 19, 2010.
REPORTS OF OFFICERS
3. FISCAL YEAR 2010/2011 CITY, COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION AND HOUSING AUTHORITY BUDGETS (See related Item #6 on the Community Development Commission Agenda and Item #1 on the Housing Authority Agenda)
Staff Report
Proposed Budget
Director Quijano presented the report to the Council / Commission / Authority, which was a balanced budget with a small surplus
Mayor Pro Tem Pacheco wanted to clarify that the funds for transportation and capital improvements came from other sources and that was what covered the $4 million budget for capital improvements. He inquired if the reserve would be higher than what they were shown in the study session
Director Quijano explained that the information was being presented differently, now showing a beginning and ending balance
Mayor Pro Tem Pacheco wanted to make sure that the mid-year budget tied in the goals and objectives set by each department to rate successes. He expressed the desire to see some type of report, possibly on a quarterly basis. He had reservations about the budget regarding take-aways from the State and what type of impact it would have on the city, but supported the budget as presented.
Motion: Approve the Fiscal Year 2010-11 budget as presented and waive further reading, read by title only and adopt Resolution No. 456 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE BUDGET OF THE CITY FOR THE FISCAL YEAR COMMENCING JULY 1, 2010 AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2011."
Moved by Mayor Lozano, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Pacheco.
ADJOURNMENT
There being no other matters for discussion the meeting was adjourned at 8:15 p.m.
Approved as presented by the Commission at their meeting held July 21, 2010.
Laura M. Nieto, CMC
Deputy City Clerk
